## How to get the real files and keep copyright risk down

1. **10 Tampa Bay / TEGNA — best first request for a bundle of the case reporting and courtroom shots.** Email **TEGNA@nimia.com**, the licensing representative listed on [WTSP’s about page](https://www.wtsp.com/about-us). Send the source links and exact preview windows. Ask whether their license covers material inside their reports that originated with police, a private camera owner, the family, or a court-pool camera.
2. **Tampa Police — original April and December video, briefings, and case-scene leads.** Contact **tpd-pio@tampagov.net**, **(813) 276-3255**, via [TPD Media Relations](https://www.tampa.gov/police/contact-us/media-relations-office). Ask about available non-graphic scene footage, the distinct 3:33/3:36 views, the owners of both surveillance clips, permission to reuse the police briefings, and the photographer/family contact for Jevario’s portraits. If a formal records request is necessary, the police page links its public-records portal. A record being publicly accessible is not itself a reuse license.
3. **WFLA / Nexstar — the early neighborhood/possible scene footage.** For commercial video licensing and archive searches, email **license@nexstar.tv**, as stated on [WFLA’s contact page](https://www.wfla.com/contact-us/). Specifically ask them to identify the location/date of the `S11` shots around 0:41–0:46 and 0:51–0:52, and whether they have non-graphic April 17 footage of this investigation.
4. **WFTS / Tampa Bay 28 — family and funeral coverage.** Contact **NewsTips@wfts.com** or **(813) 354-2828** via [the station’s contact page](https://www.tampabay28.com/about/contact-us) and ask to be referred to its footage-licensing contact. That is a newsroom contact, not a grant of rights.
5. **FOX 13 — actual no-bond and sentencing clips.** Its [published policy](https://www.fox13news.com/copies-of-newscasts) says it does not provide copies of its stories or raw footage, supports links/embedding, and regards uploading copied segments as infringement. Ask its switchboard **(813) 876-1313** or news desk **FOX13tampanews@fox.com** for a rights referral or separately licensed source; neither contact is a licensing grant. Buying a personal copy does not itself provide reuse rights.
6. **Court and still photography.** Ask the [Thirteenth Judicial Circuit](https://www.fljud13.org/About/Contact-Us) at **publicinfo@fljud13.org**, **(813) 272-5894**, whether an authorized recording or pool-camera contact exists for the December 2024 hearing and 2026 proceedings. The court may not own a broadcast recording. For a Times courtroom photograph, see the [Times image-licensing FAQ](https://www.tampabay.com/photo-gallery/reprints/faq/); a personal reprint is different from a license, and availability of the particular case image must be confirmed.
7. **State Attorney’s Office — possible non-graphic trial exhibits.** The [Times’ trial report](https://www.tampabay.com/news/crime/2026/09/01/tampa-hillsborough-jahmir-moore-jevario-buie-murder-trial/) says prosecutors showed jurors video they identified as Moore walking away. I have not located that specific video for public viewing or confirmed that it corresponds to the police’s 3:36 description. Ask **publicrecords@hillsboroughsao.gov**, **(813) 274-1938**, whether a non-graphic, publicly releasable version exists and who controls reuse; see its [public-records page](https://hillsboroughsao.gov/contact-us/public-records/). Do not request or use graphic exhibits or private phone contents. Records may be withheld, redacted or subject to fees. The office notes that emails sent to it may be public records.

For each request, specify **monetized YouTube documentary**, worldwide online distribution, intended term, approximate seconds, whether you want video and/or audio, promotional clips, and any crop/reframe. Save the written approval and required credit. Copyright ownership can be layered; a broadcaster’s permission may not cover an embedded family photo or private CCTV. Credit is useful but is not itself permission. Fair use is fact-specific, and there is no automatic safe number of seconds: see the [U.S. Copyright Office FAQ](https://www.copyright.gov/help/faq/faq-fairuse.html). No one can promise zero claims or lawsuits.

### Copy-and-send request: 10 Tampa Bay footage

**To:** TEGNA@nimia.com  
**Subject:** Licensing request — Jevario Buie / Jahmir Moore case footage

Hello, I produce The Last Timeline, a non-fiction YouTube documentary. I would like a quote and written permission for excerpts from the following 10 Tampa Bay reports, for worldwide online distribution on a monetized channel, including reasonable editing/cropping and related short promotional excerpts:

- April family/railroad-area report: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z0GGKSasvIg — approximately 0:30–0:35 and 0:42–0:46.
- December arrest report: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B5qzKsfKcAA — approximately 0:58–1:10 and 1:20–1:28.
- December escape report: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pL4PoqPMafw — approximately 0:00–0:18.

- Sentencing report: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YIDP32FMSho — approximately 0:10–0:22.

Please confirm whether the railroad shots are from the area of this investigation and when they were recorded, the available license term and required credit, whether narration-over and/or source audio is covered, and whether any embedded photographs, CCTV or courtroom video require separate clearance. Thank you.

### Copy-and-send request: Tampa Police

**To:** tpd-pio@tampagov.net  
**Subject:** Publicly releasable footage and rights inquiry — Jevario Buie investigation

Hello, I am researching a documentary on the Jevario Buie investigation. Could you identify the owner and reuse/clearance contact for the April surveillance video your department released on May 9, 2024 (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a0NS9AsqdeA), and the business-camera escape video released December 8, 2024 (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5pMeJcySADY)? Please also advise whether non-graphic video or photographs of the April 17 investigation, or the separate 3:33 p.m. and 3:36 p.m. surveillance views described in the December arrest release, are publicly available. I am not requesting graphic victim imagery, residential details, or private phone contents. Finally, who can authorize documentary reuse of the department’s press-conference footage and connect us with the appropriate rights holder for the family-released Jevario photographs? Thank you.

### Exact-scene follow-up for WFLA

Send `S11` to **license@nexstar.tv** and ask: “Do the images at approximately 0:41–0:46 show police working the Jevario Buie investigation, and do the railroad images at 0:51–0:52 show its location? On what date were they filmed? Do you have any non-graphic original footage from the April 17 response, and who can authorize documentary reuse?” Until they answer, the wooded-area shot remains **a candidate, not confirmed crime-scene footage**.
